versions.changelog:
FluxA Agent Wallet v1.4.5 introduces expanded documentation, new integration guides, and improved onboarding for AI agents and users.

- Added comprehensive integration and scenario guides (e.g., ClawPI, scheduled check-ins, agent transfers, mandate planning, oneshot APIs, VC issuing).
- Updated documentation to clarify setup, linking, and wallet usage workflow for AI agents.
- Expanded use-case support, detailing AI social gifting, automated skills, pay-per-use APIs, and more.
- Improved "Opening Authorization URLs" pattern for a more user-centric experience.
- CLI transition: updated instructions to use the global npm package (@fluxa-pay/fluxa-wallet) instead of a local script bundle.
- Removed legacy CLI bundle file (scripts/fluxa-cli.bundle.js).

Initial public release of FluxA Agent Wallet skill.

- Integrates FluxA Agent Wallet CLI for AI agents to make crypto payments, send USDC payouts, and create payment links.
- Supports x402 protocol payments for paid APIs, USDC transfers, and invoice-style payment links.
- Provides setup guide, command list, amount formats, and environment variable configuration.
- Runs as a standalone Node.js CLI with JSON output—no npm install required.
- Requires initial agent registration; auto-refreshes JWT as needed.
